architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Reusable components in src/components/. Static assets in public/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management lib (local state sufficient).

tickets.title: Create LandingPage component from sugi.dev_landing_page_integrated
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Extract hero section, marquee, CTA buttons. Keep exact visual fidelity. Use Tailwind classes. Static data for now.

tickets.title: Create HomePage component from sugi.dev_portfolio_home_final
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Include work showcase grid, services preview, about snippet. Extract reusable ProjectCard component. Static data.

tickets.title: Create WorkPage component from sugi.dev_work_final
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Full project showcase with filtering UI. Extract FilterTabs and ProjectDetail components. Static data.

tickets.title: Create AboutPage component from sugi.dev_about_page
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Include bio section, skills grid, experience timeline. Extract SkillsGrid component. Static data.

tickets.title: Create ServicesPage component from services_sugi.dev
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Service offerings grid, pricing cards, FAQ section. Extract ServiceCard and FAQItem components. Static data.

tickets.title: Create ContactPage component from contact_clean_background
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML. Contact form, social links, map placeholder. Form validation (client-side only). Static data for social links.

tickets.title: Create reusable UI components from component reference screens
tickets.description: Convert Stitch component HTML to reusable React components. Buttons (primary/secondary), badges, tables. Tailwind classes. Prop-based variants.
acceptance_criteria: Exact visual match for all variants
Storybook stories optional (skip if time tight)

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create main App shell. Navigation bar (mobile/desktop). React Router setup with routes for all pages. 404 page. Footer from sugidev_collection_footer_section. Dark/light mode toggle (UI only).
acceptance_criteria: Dark/light mode toggle (UI only, no persistence)
